findings.target: Slot C article, claim: 改编自雨果奖获奖短篇小说
findings.evidence: Independent web search (Douban subject/35875462, Baidu Baike/60821440, QQ News/20260704A063GF00) shows NO mention of Hugo Award adaptation. Only one Sina overview article (ent.sina.cn 2026-07-04) makes this claim — the same article that also had an incorrect release date (7月20日 vs actual 8月1日). Film credits show original screenplay by 胡晓曦 and 章笛沙.
findings.counterexample_or_failure_mode: The Hugo Award claim may be factually incorrect. If published, it exposes the article to factual challenge.
findings.required_fix: Either (a) remove the Hugo Award claim from the article, replacing it with a verified fact, or (b) cite the specific Hugo-winning story title and author with corroborating source, or (c) mark it as '据部分媒体报道' with attribution to the Sina overview.
findings.recheck: Verify the Hugo claim with a second independent authoritative source, or remove it.

findings.target: Slot C candidate data: event_time 2026-07-20 vs actual release 2026-08-01
findings.evidence: QQ News 2026-07-09 article confirms preview screenings July 10-16, full release August 1. Eastmoney confirms box office 4000万 from preview only.
findings.counterexample_or_failure_mode: The article correctly states 8月1日 release, so the candidate pool data is stale but the article is accurate. This is a data quality issue, not an article defect.
findings.required_fix: Update candidate-pool.json event_time and freshness_window for cand-003, or document as known gap.
findings.recheck: Confirm the article itself correctly states 8月1日.

findings.target: Slot A article: '有影评人直言' quote lacks attribution
findings.evidence: The article says '有影评人直言' without naming the critic. Source src-A02 (Weibo aggregation) does contain similar quotes but attribution is to Weibo usernames.
findings.counterexample_or_failure_mode: Vague attribution weakens the claim's credibility.
findings.required_fix: Attribute to specific source: either name the Weibo user or cite '新浪电影评论区'.

findings.target: Slot B article: alignment with candidate angle
findings.evidence: Candidate angle is '片方沉默背后的压力'. The article focuses on the withdrawal event and the film's significance, but does not strongly explore '压力' (pressure) — i.e. who applied pressure, why, what the censorship/regulatory dynamic was.
findings.counterexample_or_failure_mode: Slight angle drift; the article is more about 'what was lost' than 'who/what caused it to be lost'.
findings.required_fix: Either adjust angle in candidate or add a paragraph exploring the regulatory/censorship dimension.
